identification: Chinese Satsuma-style (moriage) lidded two-handled porcelain bowl/tureen with gilt gourd finial, black and cream ground with raised dot beadwork and flowers and birds, in a fabric (brocade/silk) presentation box with toggle. Lid appears to have a hairline crack or old repair at the rim (photo 2). Bowl holds some odds (what looks like cufflinks or a pen, chopsticks, coins/cord), which may or may not be included. Looks like modern Chinese export decorative ware imitating Japanese Meiji Satsuma, not antique Satsuma, but no base mark was photographed.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 20-30, current bid $10. Check the base for any mark (Japanese Satsuma marks versus Made in China), the lid crack, and what is in the bowl. Terapeak AU only shows genuine Japanese Meiji pieces (A$71 to A$195, 2024 to 2026), so if this is a modern Chinese copy those prices do not apply. The 4 sold comparables are different items. Silk box is a modern giftware box.
